title: LTS compatibility contracts and rollback orchestration
creator: Marco Reyes
description:
Goal: Define a single-source LTS compatibility contract and an executable upgrade/rollback orchestration for runtime, public API, official SDKs, and Console. Deliverables: (1) a machine-readable compatibility matrix that CI can assert against for every candidate release, (2) rollout gate criteria per channel (stable, LTS, canary), (3) an upgrade orchestration blueprint that supports automated partial rollouts and timed automatic rollback on regressions, and (4) a migration playbook for customers and Dedicated/Private deployments.

Scope: runtime (inference serving binary + kernels), HTTP API surface (v*), SDKs (python/js/go), Console (UI + backend routes). This ticket focuses on the design+automation hooks; implementation follow-ups will be split into per-surface tasks.

Compatibility matrix (current working draft format - to be committed as YAML in infra/compat):
- Column headers: surface | semantic-version-range | stable-compat | lts-compat | rolling-compat | required-feature-flags | test-suite-tag
- Example rows:
  - runtime | 1.18.x - 1.20.x | yes | yes (1.18+) | no | kv-cache-v2,batched-kernels | runtime-smoke,kvcache-regressions
  - api | v1.* | yes | yes (v1) | yes | api-deprecation-header | api-contract-e2e
  - sdk-python | 0.17.x - 0.19.x | yes | no (recommend upgrade) | no | retry-backport | sdk-integration
  - console | 2025.01 - 2025.03 | yes | yes | no | console-feature-gates | console-ui-smoke

Acceptance criteria (must be automated where possible):
- CI job fails a candidate release if compatibility matrix assertions break for the LTS channel.
- Rollout gate runs automated regression checks (latency, error-rate, end-to-end inference quality) and tags canary with rollback policy when thresholds exceeded.
- Upgrade orchestration supports: canary % by cluster, automatic time-based promotion, and safe rollback command with forensic logs.
- Public docs: customer upgrade playbook + Console UI guidance for pinning to LTS channels.

Non-goals: changing semantic versioning rules for API; this ticket consumes existing semver policy and encodes enforcement for channels.

Next steps: finalize YAML schema, implement CI assertion job, prototype orchestration in k8s/helm-ops, draft customer playbook and Console UI copy for channel selection.
